nodes.label: Do's and Don'ts
nodes.rationale: Keep state honest, 44px taps, transform-only motion, no neon, no card shadows, no continuous effects on always-on screen.

nodes.label: The Gold Hardware Rule
nodes.rationale: Brass gold too dark for text on green; use Gold Text for gold-toned text; gold never fills a card.

nodes.label: The Night Layer Rule
nodes.rationale: Fixed #03140d layer at .45 opacity dims dashboard between sunset and sunrise; click-through; only full-screen overlay.

nodes.label: The One Weight Plate Rule
nodes.rationale: Marcellus at 400 only; hierarchy from size.

nodes.label: Creative North Star: A Room of Poodle House
nodes.norm_label: creative north star: a room of poodle house
nodes.rationale: Sibling room of the Poodle House theme; tokens copied by value; adds only flow colours, LIVE red, error tint and night layer. Rejects the retired lime/coral/cyan neon dashboard.

nodes.label: The Tabular Readout Rule
nodes.rationale: Refreshing figures use tabular-nums so digits do not shift on a wall screen.

nodes.label: The Three Paths Rule
nodes.rationale: Solar diagram owns exactly three user-confirmed flow colours: sun, battery, grid.

nodes.label: Principle: Light on hardware
nodes.rationale: Features must justify running cost on low-power always-on devices.

nodes.label: Gold/Green/White Palette
